source: UniProtKB reviewed records; organism_id 83333 (E. coli K-12)
query_template: (organism_id:83333) AND (reviewed:true) AND (length:[50 TO 300]) AND (cc_scl_term:INCLUDE) AND NOT (cc_scl_term:EXCLUDE)
selection: First 100 accession-sorted results per query; standard 20 amino acids only; exact sequence deduplication; shuffle random_state=42; first 60 per class.
grouping: Connected components: Biopython local alignment, BLOSUM62, gap open -10, extend -0.5; >=30% identity among paired residues and paired residues covering >=80% of each sequence. Not exhaustive homology detection.
split: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42): fold 0 test, fold 1 validation, remaining training.
limitations: Small annotation-derived teaching set, not a representative benchmark.
Related families may remain across splits despite similarity grouping.
ESM pretraining may include these proteins or relatives; this is not an unseen-sequence benchmark.
Membrane annotation includes diverse associations and is not restricted to transmembrane proteins.
No claim that embeddings outperform composition.
